text:
maya: Heads up — product sync: need to finalize Optimize toolkit MVP scope for handoff to Eng next week. Key asks from customers: per-route batching config suggestions, prefix caching heuristics, and a quantization recommendation flow. Need clear launch gates. Thoughts?

jonathan: +1. From CS calls, customers want a 'safe' quantization suggestion (e.g., 8-bit/4-bit tradeoffs) and a quick eval that checks hallucination/regression. :thumbsup:

liam: For batching/caching, ops asked for SLA guardrails — we can't batch so much that tail latency spikes. Propose two knobs: target p50 latency and cost cap. We can generate batching profiles.

eva: Agree. Also need eval-triggered alerts — if eval set drops below threshold, trigger a rollback or notify owners. Question: where do we host evals? Redwood Console or customer-managed? :eyes:

priya: Customers prefer Console-managed with opt-in, but need private data support for some enterprise pilots.

sam: Engineering constraints: Dedicated runtime can surface per-model quant profiles but private deploy complicates metrics ingestion. Suggest implement eval-alerts via webhook first (webhook -> customer infra or partner).

maya: Ok decision point: MVP should include: 1) automated batching suggestion (per-route histograms -> profiles), 2) caching heuristics + config generator, 3) quant recommendation with lightweight eval, 4) eval-alerts delivery via webhook + Console UI opt-in. Anything to trim?

rafael: Trim caching config generator to only prefix-KV suggestions (not full content hashing) to save time.

jonathan: Launch criteria: docs + sample prompts for each eval, integration tests that simulate traffic, two pilot customers signed off, and observability dashboard (basic).

liam: Engineering estimate: 4 sprints for batching+heuristics, 3 sprints for quant recommendation (model onboarding required), 2 sprints for alerts + webhooks. Parallelize where possible. Risk: cross-team infra for metrics.

eva: For rollout plan: canary in Hosted, then Dedicated, then Private. For Private, need a migration plan to accept local evals; maybe v1 is manual upload.

priya: Customer asks: ability to override suggestions and to store profiles per-route. Must be in API v1.

sam: Implementation note (from Eng): proto API for suggestions:
```json
{"route":"chat","profile":{"batch_size":32,"timeout_ms":50,"cache_prefix_chars":10,"quant_profile":"int8-safe"}}
```
include endpoint /v1/optimize/suggest

release-bot: Reminder: freeze for release candidate next Thursday.

maya: Handoff checklist for Eng: feature spec, data contract (histograms + eval schema), acceptance criteria, customer pilot contacts. I'll draft spec today.

jonathan: Add success metrics: 15% median token cost reduction for batchable routes, <5% quality regressions on eval sets, 99th percentile latency doesn't exceed baseline + 20ms.

rafael: Suggestion: include 'explainability' strings with suggestions so customers can see why we choose settings (e.g., 'high prefix reuse -> cache enabled').

eva: For alerts, we should include severity levels and automated rollback policy toggles.

maya: Great. I'll draft an initial spec and attach a short pilot SOW. Who can take primary eng contact?

sam: I'll lead Eng work, liam as infra liaison, rafael on UX.

priya: I'll coordinate pilot customers and ensure compliance needs for Private deployments.

maya: Thanks — I'll post the spec here in the morning. Anything else?

jonathan: put a reminder to update SDKs and console docs 1 sprint after feature is merged.

ops-bot: Scheduled: ops sync w/ infra on metrics streaming — Friday 10am.

maya: closing: sounds like a plan, will include rough timeline and risks in the spec. :white_check_mark:
